$:set -euo pipefail
printf 'HEAD '; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'AGENTS_SHA '; git hash-object AGENTS.md
printf 'ROOT_README '; test -f README.md && (cat README.md | head -n 80) || echo absent
printf 'APPLICABLE_AGENTS '; find terminal -name AGENTS.md -print 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'APPLICABLE_README '; find terminal/tasks/fishFry -name README.md -print 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'SOURCE '; file terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_arrow_90_clockwise.png
printf 'SOURCE_SHA256 '; sha256sum terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_arrow_90_clockwise.png
printf 'FILECOUNT '; ls -1 terminal/tasks/fishFry | wc -l
printf 'BRANCH '; git branch --show-current
printf 'REMOTE '; git remote get-url origin
printf 'PIL '; python3 -c 'from PIL import Image; print(Image.__version__)' 2>&1 || true
printf 'REGISTRY '; test -f .github/issue-workflow-registry.json && echo present || echo absent
